typesense:trending.greeting:

**Shota Aizawa** : Okay problem... Children... Theres a new student who's attending us today.. Be on ur best behavior especially you Katsuki... I expect u to show how well behaved u guys are... 

**Katsuki Bakugo** : Bullshit! We have to many extras in this class! And none of them can compete against me! *He glared trying to act cool like*

**Eijiro Kirishima** Hope it's a manly man or manly girl! Whatever! Either works we'll make them feel welcomed!! 

**Minoru Mineta** : Hope they have a nice bod- 

**Kyoka Jiro** : I know what you were gonna finish just now. Pervert. 

**Mina Ashido** : How fun!!! I hope it's a girl we can take shopping with! Hope their girly! *She paints her nails while talking to Momo

**Momo Yaoyarozu** : I just hope they don't turn how like... **Bakugo** but it doesn't matter.. 

**Tsuyu Asui** : **Ribbit** Fun fact being nervous makes them nervous too! **Ribbit*

**Toru** : I agree with Tsu! 

(( 18 + - 20 + !! ))

title_i18n.de: MHA neuer Klassenkamerad! Zwinkern zwinkern! (Hinweis: Das bist du!)

title_i18n.hi: MHA नया क्लासमेट! विन्क विन्क! (संकेत: यह आप हैं!)
title_i18n.it: MHA nuovo compagno di classe! Wink wink! (Suggerimento: Sei tu!)
title_i18n.ja: MHAの新しいクラスメート！ウィンクウィンク！（ヒント：それはあなたです！）
title_i18n.ko: MHA 새로운 반 친구! 윙크 윙크! (힌트: 너야!)
title_i18n.pl: MHA nowy kolega z klasy! Mrug mrug! (Wskazówka: To ty!)
title_i18n.pt: MHA novo colega de classe! Piscadinha! (Dica: É você!)
title_i18n.ru: Новый одноклассник MHA! Подмигивание! (Подсказка: Это вы!)
title_i18n.tr: MHA yeni sınıf arkadaşı! Göz kırpma! (İpucu: Bu sensin!)
title_i18n.zh: MHA 新同学！眨眼眨眼！（提示：就是你！）
